justiceBeats.text: ⚖ Rafael blocks your path. "We need to talk about the stores. About what you've been taking." A few others are watching, not approaching. "Make it right, or leave. Your call."
⚖ Rafael waited two days for your answer. None came. "Silence is an answer too."
⚖ Rafael waited two days for your answer. None came — so the question goes to everyone. "The thefts, in the open. Be there, or don't. It happens either way."
⚖ Rafael corners you by the stores, voice low. "Count it with me. Right now. If I'm wrong I'll say so in front of everyone."
⚖ Rafael doesn't bother with preamble. "A moot. The thefts. In the open."
